title: Choron Ka Chor
overview: Dara Singh plays a masked bandit referred to as Choran Ka Chor (Thief of Thieves) who is a modern day Robin Hood. He tangles with an international cartel of smugglers while also looking out for a destitute family who are about to be thrown out onto the street because they cannot pay the rent. He is assisted by his sidekicks Makhan and Lakhan.
